response.goal: Set up a two-way contact sync between HubSpot and the PostgreSQL users table so that new signups appear in HubSpot within 5 minutes and lifecycle stage changes in HubSpot are written back to PostgreSQL, with recent updates winning and conflicts logged.

plan.step: Kickoff and API credential setup for HubSpot and PostgreSQL
Build one-way signup sync from PostgreSQL to HubSpot within 5 minutes
Build one-way lifecycle stage write-back from HubSpot to PostgreSQL
Implement last-write-wins conflict resolution and conflict logging
Deploy on client server and write README for developer maintenance

milestones.name: Milestone 1: Core Sync Logic
milestones.deliverable: Two-way contact synchronization for signups and lifecycle stages with conflict resolution.

milestones.name: Milestone 2: Deployment and Documentation
milestones.deliverable: Running service on the client server with a complete maintenance README.

risks.risk: HubSpot API rate limits may impact the 5-minute sync requirement during traffic spikes.
risks.mitigation: Implement efficient batching and retry logic with exponential backoff.

risks.risk: Clock drift between servers and HubSpot could cause incorrect last-write-wins conflict resolution.
risks.mitigation: Use NTP-synchronized server time and rely on HubSpot's server-side modification timestamps where available.
